description: Log in to Mockzilla cloud so the hosted tools (deploying mocks, listing simulations, the catalog) become available. Opens the Mockzilla login in the user's browser, where they pick an organization and read-only or read-and-write access. Returns right away with the login `url`. Call it when a hosted tool says it needs a login, then call that tool again once the user approves. Local tools never need it. Side effects: starts a short-lived listener on 127.0.0.1 for the login callback, and saves the login under ~/.config/mockzilla-mcp/.
name: login
